items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Boynell and Mitchell was two stars. They worked together on the same piano.

ctx.x: Who were some of the piano players around when you were coming up?

The piano players? This boy here, Noonie. Noonie Perez, who was a, Bauhaus piano player. Because I was playing with Son Wilson then, trumpet player and that was, he's a piano player. And they real tunk, you know what I mean? Yeah, I know. Real tunk, yeah, yeah. I know from, and Simon, Simon, Boynel San Diego, Black San Diego, Mitchell Frazier.
Was he any kind of Simon?

items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Boynell and Mitchell was two stars. They worked together on the same piano.

ctx.x: I don't think I ever knew him. He probably played.

He was way back. He was the one from way back. He died. Yeah, Plutzum. He would tie him up with Simon and Mitchell Frazier and all them, and Elliott Frazier and all them boys played piano. What you know about that? And Simon always was a good man. Simon left the liquor kit. But Boynell and Mitchell was two stars. They worked together on the same piano. And they fit right together, huh?
